task:
УТОЧНЕНИЕ к апгрейду (по фидбэку юзера) — это задача на ВЫПОЛНЕНИЕ, не обсуждение:
1) НЕ хардкодь yolo11x дефолтом. Дефолт в configs/live-webcam.yaml = yolo11m (баланс FPS/точность для непрерывных камер). Модель остаётся настраиваемой через конфиг.
2) Добавь conf_threshold=0.4 в DetectorConfig + примени в UltralyticsDetector.
3) ДЕМО: прогони ОДИН раз yolo11x на реальной камере device 0 (показать потолок качества юзеру), сохрани runs/webcam-proof-v2.png + лог детекций (класс+conf).
ЦЕЛЬ: новый proof-кадр с хорошим распознаванием + сбалансированный дефолт. ВЫПОЛНИ (конфиг+код+прогон), верни реальный кадр.
goal: Generate a new proof image demonstrating good recognition quality and establish a balanced default model configuration.
constraints: Do not hardcode 'yolo11x' as the default model.
The model must remain configurable via the configuration file.
The task is for execution, not discussion.
The demo run using 'yolo11x' must be performed only once.
The demo run must use 'device 0' (a real camera).
known_context: The task is a refinement based on user feedback for an ongoing upgrade.
The configuration file for the default model is 'configs/live-webcam.yaml'.
'DetectorConfig' and 'UltralyticsDetector' are existing components that require modification.
The output path for the demo proof image is 'runs/webcam-proof-v2.png'.
'yolo11m' is considered a balanced model for FPS/accuracy on continuous cameras.
output_format: A JSON object containing the path to the generated proof image ('runs/webcam-proof-v2.png'), and a structured log of detections (class and confidence) from the demo run. The updated configuration files and relevant code changes should also be part of the overall deliverable.
success_tests: The 'configs/live-webcam.yaml' file must specify 'yolo11m' as the default model.
The system must allow overriding the default model (e.g., to 'yolo11x') via configuration.
The 'DetectorConfig' class/structure must include a 'conf_threshold' parameter with a default value of '0.4'.
The 'UltralyticsDetector' implementation must utilize the 'conf_threshold' value from 'DetectorConfig' during detection.
A file named 'runs/webcam-proof-v2.png' must be created, containing a detection result from 'yolo11x' on 'device 0'.
A log of detections (including class and confidence for each detected object) corresponding to the 'runs/webcam-proof-v2.png' image must be provided.
